item.title: Staff Post- Deletion Vote
item.content:encoded:
Beginning deletion vote at -11.

If you are not the author and you want to rewrite this article, you may reply to this post asking for the opportunity to do so. Please obtain permission from the author (or the Rewrite Team if this article is older than 6 months) and make sure you copy the page source to your sandbox. Please do not reply to this post for any other reason unless you are staff.

item.title: Re: Thank you :)
item.content:encoded:
Hi promethcookie! I noticed a few very common mistakes in your draft, such as overuse of text formatting such as underlining, inserting lines to add space when formatting exists that can add blank line breaks, and using imperial measurements in some places and metric in others. On top of that, there were a large number of spelling and grammar errors, especially in the interview at the end. You also need to make sure that any images you include in your SCP are compliant with the Creative Commons Share-Alike 3.0 license - which I assume an edited photo of a nun costume is not - or else it will be removed from the article.

For first-time wiki contributors, it's recommended that you seek critique on the forums before posting. The ideas forum is a great place to start to get your core idea critiqued before moving on to the drafting phase, then to get critique on your draft and post once it is polished.

None of this is mandatory, but most new contributors find a much greater chance of success going this route.

item.title: Thank you :)
item.content:encoded: This is my first ever SCP and also I am new to this site. I'll make sure to keep these mistakes in mind and correct myself. Thank you very much :)

item.content:encoded:
Ok, firstly I think the visual for the map of site-15 A is too small and hard to read and too many underlines make it confusing, the article itself is understandable but I don't see much to really grab my attention, it is interesting but is "generic scary thing but religion related"
(but I would prefer if the rendering had a rosary since most Christian nuns carry a rosary)

And it is not really that scary, not very disturbing either, though that is much of personal opinion.

Next I don't think it is realistic that the containment procedures require clearance, since what if all the people with clearance were busy with other SCP's then any remaining personnel would not be able to execute the procedure.
